title: S05T05 - Ship spec/change search, console views, templates, and end-to-end fixtures
description: Make linked specifications and changes visible in context packs, search, work templates, console detail, and complete proposal-to-archive fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Search and context explain whether a result is current truth, proposed change, design, task, scenario, delta, or archive.
A complete fixture proves proposal, review, work creation, implementation, witnessed verification, acceptance, archive, and impact trace.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
